OeDataAcces

R package for config based data fetching from PostgreSQL databases in R.

The package is intended to facilitate config based execution of set of SQL queries against a set of PostGreSQL database backends. The general wrokflow is:

  • configure database connections in a JSON files
  • register SQL files (one query per file) in a config file that matches them with a connection
  • run get_datasets(get_config(), queries) where queries is a list of names of registered queries.

The primary use case is ease database access in Quarto documents. Here you can list the database queries in the yaml header, which makes it easy to identify the data that is used by the Quarto document.

The get_datasets() function handles connection setup and pooling, fetching the data, and connection pool cleanup. It returns a list of datsets, where the name of the dataset corresponds to the configured query name.

Installation

Install the library using devtools.

library(devtools)
install_github('OnroerendErfgoed/OeDataAccess')

Usage 

library(OeDataAccess)

queries <- c("query1","query2")

#config takes a qry_cfg and db_cfg file, but defaults to
# `config/queries.json` and `config/db_config.json`
config <- get_config()

datasets <- get_datasets(config, queries)

head(datasets$query1)

To get started quickly, you can generate a config template in the default location in an interactive R session:

library(OeDataAcces)

setup_config()
